parts.name: Yard
parts.info: A fenced yard behind the market.

parts.name: Market shed
parts.info: The market's food stalls are under this roof.

parts.name: Digester tank
parts.info: A prefabricated, insulated tank of about 36 m³. Bacteria turn the food waste slurry into biogas over about 30 days.

part.name: Prefabricated digester tank, about 36 m³, insulated, with inlet and outlet

parts.name: Gas holder
parts.info: A flexible gas bag in a frame; it fills during the day and empties at meal times.

part.name: Flexible gas holder about 30 m³, with frame and weights

parts.name: Intake scale, shredder and feed pit
parts.info: Loads are weighed on the platform, shredded, mixed with water in the pit and pumped into the tank.

part.name: Food-waste shredder, mains powered, and feed pit pump

parts.name: Gas line to the stalls
parts.info: Through a water trap, the pulse gas meter, valves and a flame arrester to burners at the food stalls.

part.name: Gas pipe, water trap, valves, pressure gauge and flame arrester to the stalls

parts.name: Fertiliser (digestate) tank
parts.info: Digested slurry overflows here and is sold to farms as liquid fertiliser.

parts.name: Monitoring box
parts.info: FireBeetle ESP32 with two methane sensors, the slurry probe, scale and gas meter inputs, and a speaker for the leak alarm.

parts.name: Methane sensors
parts.info: One beside the gas holder outlet, one on the stall gas line.
